title: What is goal drift?
summary: Goal drift occurs when an AI agent gradually moves away from the original user objective while executing a multi-step task. The agent starts with the correct goal but eventually focuses on unrelated or unnecessary work. Task abandonment occurs when the agent stops pursuing the original goal altogether.
